intro.text: An underlestrell of the Diem and one of Drile's followers, openly scornful of Kenton.

items.text: Moril and Yeeden taunted Kenton shortly before he ran the Mastrell's Path, doubting Dirin's praise of his single ribbon. Yeeden challenged him to a game of Zo'Ken with a wager riding on it, and both were stunned when Kenton won easily. They walked off grumbling as Drile arrived to scold them for sparring with acolents.

appearance.text: Of average height and build, with medium-length red hair and fair skin; she wears a sand master's white robes with an underlestrell's purple sash.
